name: JellyTrack
description: JellyTrack is an analytics dashboard for Jellyfin. This plugin intercepts playback events, library changes and sends a periodic heartbeat to the JellyTrack server.
overview: Jellyfin plugin to push playback events to JellyTrack

versions.changelog:
## v2.1.0.0 (unreleased)
- Target .NET 10 and stable Jellyfin 12.2 APIs only (targetAbi 12.2.0.0).
- Deliver events in a bounded background queue without waiting for HTTP in Jellyfin callbacks.
- Preserve delivery order on reconnect and merge only adjacent progress observations.
- Include the Jellyfin SystemId for scoped JellyTrack Go plugin keys.
- Remove duplicate periodic heartbeat triggers and legacy reflection fallbacks.
- Real Jellyfin server validation is still required before publication.

## v2.0.0.2
- Security audit and hardening release
- Extended SSRF protection against cloud metadata endpoints (Alibaba IMDS 100.100.100.200, Azure, subdomains, and wildcard DNS evasion like nip.io/sslip.io)
- Unhandled exception resilience in background worker task to protect Jellyfin host stability
- Input length validation bounds for administrative TestConnection endpoint
- Upstream response stream sanitization filtering control characters and explicit UTF-8 JSON encoding

## v2.0.0.1
- Security hardening: SSRF & cloud metadata protection (AWS, Azure, GCP metadata endpoints)
- Prevent token leakage by disabling automatic HTTP redirects in API client
- Bounded response buffer to protect against memory exhaustion from oversized responses
- Bounded capacities on in-memory caches (media stream cache, session telemetry, library change notifier)
- Hardened configuration UI against prototype pollution and ReDoS
- Controller validation for localization language codes and sanitized error responses

## v2.0.0
- Public 2.0 release matching JellyTrack v2.0
- Official support for Jellyfin 12.0 (.NET 10) and Jellyfin 10.11 (.NET 9)
- Redesigned configuration UI with full-width API key and embedded toggle button
- Added visual connection status badges and detailed diagnostics
- Updated all dependencies to latest stable versions
- Enhanced unit test coverage

## v1.7.0
- Migrate target framework to .NET 10
- Update dependencies for Jellyfin 12.0.0-rc2 compatibility

## v1.6.0
- Target Jellyfin 12.0.x public releases
- Add schema v3 telemetry with immediate pause/resume/seek/audio/subtitle/session-end events
- Use very precise 5s playing progress with 30s paused progress by default
- Coalesce queued PlaybackProgress retries per session for large-server efficiency
- Rename the release package and assembly to Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyTrack

## v1.2.0
- Compatible with Jellyfin 12.0 / 10.12
- Replace reflection-based user resolution with direct IUserManager API
- Use [Authorize] attributes for admin endpoint protection

## v1.1.0
- Compatible with Jellyfin 10.11.8

## v1.0.9
- Disable plugin by default on fresh installs to avoid outbound calls before configuration
- Skip heartbeat sends when URL/API key are missing or still set to placeholder values
- Clarify that `Unauthorized` heartbeat logs indicate API key/runtime config issues, not repository installation failures

## v1.0.6
- Enrich PlaybackProgress payload with media metadata (title/type/duration)
- Enrich PlaybackProgress payload with session metadata (IP/client/device/playmethod)
- Improve pause state visibility and fallback behavior when PlaybackStart is missing

## v1.0.5
- Fix runtime compatibility with Jellyfin 10.11 by removing fragile direct user API calls
- Resolve users via reflection fallback for heartbeat and playback events
- Improve delivery diagnostics in logs for sent JellyTrack events

## v1.0.3
- Move connection test to a server-side plugin endpoint instead of browser fetch
- Return detailed HTTP error messages during plugin connection tests
- Send an immediate heartbeat after saving plugin configuration

## v1.0.2
- Fix UUID formatting in all events (canonical GUID format)
- Register heartbeat task explicitly in DI
- Improve API client endpoint normalization and send Authorization + X-Api-Key

## v1.0.0
- Initial release
- PlaybackStart / PlaybackStop / PlaybackProgress events
- Heartbeat with user sync
- Library change notifications with debounce
- Admin configuration page
